description: Compatibility between two people (partners, crushes, friends, family) from their names, birth dates, places and, if known, times. No account needed and nothing is saved. Returns the strongest connections between the two charts and compatibilityUrl, a link that opens the free compatibility preview on celestio.ai with both people filled in.

latitude.description: Optional: exact latitude; with longitude and timeZone it overrides the place search

place.description: Birth place as "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Sofia, Bulgaria"

time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour ("14:30") or 12-hour ("2:30 PM", "2:30 p.m.", "2pm"). Leave out when unknown: the chart then has no rising sign or houses

relationship.description: What the two people are to each other. Default partner
